title: Desaparecidos
goal: Read how enforced disappearance worked as a deliberate method, the official denial that surrounded it, and how the Mothers of Plaza de Mayo turned grief into a lasting form of resistance.
grammar: Aun cuando: una concesión más fuerte que aunque

items: Explain what enforced disappearance consisted of.
Describe how the government denied knowing where the disappeared were.
Describe how the Mothers of Plaza de Mayo kept marching despite repression.
Explain what happened to founder Azucena Villaflor.
Use aun cuando for a strong concession.
